# Offgrid Comms Tracker

> A free, community buyer's guide that tracks price and stock for MeshCore and Meshtastic radios from U.S. and international sellers. Stock is checked about once an hour. The site receives no commissions.

## Main pages
- [All radios (plain list with price and stock)](https://mesh.davidandlaura.net/radios.php): every tracked radio, grouped by availability.
- [Interactive catalog](https://mesh.davidandlaura.net/): filter by use, firmware, warehouse, radio type and price.
- [Price history](https://mesh.davidandlaura.net/prices.html): how prices and stock have moved over time.
- [Local groups directory](https://mesh.davidandlaura.net/groups.php): Meshtastic and MeshCore groups in every U.S. state, with a map. Compiled by an automated search and not endorsed.
- [Phone alerts](https://mesh.davidandlaura.net/alerts.html): get a free ntfy alert on restocks and price drops.

## Feeds
- [Stock and price changes (RSS)](https://mesh.davidandlaura.net/feed.php)
